kind: Hand-authored SkyPatcher configuration overlay; no plugin and no vendor bytes

ckFirst.nativeAnswer: Use MO2's exact virtual-path override to replace only the accidental second SkyPatcher config with a comment-only no-op. No Creation Kit record, ESPFE, Papyrus, or native code is required.
ckFirst.codeJustification: The INI is hand-authored. Python is used only to fail closed on vendor-source drift, run regression checks, and package the owned files reproducibly; it does not generate game data.

leveledListRules.semantics: SkyPatcher source directly assigns chanceNone, so a later processed directive wins. The September 3 log placed this file after vendor configs, but opendir/readdir traversal does not guarantee lexical zz order; each launch must verify effective order until these rules are made order-independent.

transformation.method: Hand-author one comment-only file at the exact erroneous Headgear virtual path. Retain the existing owned leveled-list configuration unchanged except for factual comments correcting SkyPatcher ordering and the 13-plus-MQ304 outfit count.
transformation.reproduction: The builder uses stored ZIP members, a fixed 2000-01-01 timestamp, sorted POSIX member paths, fixed Unix 0644 attributes, and byte-pinned LF source files. Two independent builds must have the recorded archive hash.

featureDefaultsDiff.reason: No source-built runtime component or defaults file; the new exact-path shadow is deliberately directive-free.
